title: What Is Informative Writing? — Informative Writing for Kids
skills: define informative writing and identify its purpose
distinguish informative writing from narrative and opinion writing
organize facts and explanations around a clear topic
use relevant information to explain a subject clearly to an audience
alignment_note: Provides an accessible introduction to informative writing and its purpose of explaining a topic using clear facts and details. Although designed for younger learners, it can serve as foundational review, intervention, or multilingual reinforcement for expository structure, nonfiction writing, and audience-focused communication across high school English courses.
